maria: Opening a small docs PR to tighten up the semi-airgapped/private install flow. Scope: clear bootstrap steps, a tiny conn-check script for operators, explicit KMS/HSM env examples, and a short migration link update. @jamie @sachin please focus on networking + KMS sections for accuracy.

jamie: Sounds good. Can you separate the PR into two commits: (A) copy edits + link fixes + known-limitations, (B) example scripts/snippets. Easier to back out if needed. Also flag devex for any button/UX wording we mention. :+1:

maria: Yup, planning that. Draft description includes a one-line smoke-test and a test-plan checklist. Pasted the conn-check helper below (will move to examples/semiairgap/conn-check.sh after review):

```bash
# conn-check.sh - quick connectivity checks for semi-airgapped installs
set -e
# try metadata (may be blocked in sealed sites)
if curl -sSf --connect-timeout 5 http://169.254.169.254 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "metadata reachable"
else
  echo "metadata unreachable (expected on sealed sites)"
fi
# check KMS and HSM ports commonly required by installs
if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nc -zv kms.local 5696 || echo "KMS API port 5696 unreachable"
  nc -zv hsm.local 5697 || echo "HSM admin port 5697 unreachable"
else
  curl -sSf --connect-timeout 5 http://kms.local:5696/health || echo "kms health endpoint failed"
fi
```

maria: Also added an example systemd override for RHEL-like distros where service units don't pick up env files by default: `systemctl edit redwood-installer.service` with `Environment=REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/libpkcs11.so` (note path may vary by vendor).

sachin: For the KMS/HSM note: please explicitly call out the PKCS#11 library env names we set in the installer (REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB, REDWOOD_HSM_SLOT) and add the two ports in the firewall table (5696 for KMS API, 5697 for HSM admin). A few customers assumed 443-only; that caused blocked installs. I'll drop a short SELinux troubleshooting snippet if folks want it.

maria: Added a short SELinux pointer under troubleshooting and a quick MTU workaround under Known limitations (VXLAN + MTU 1500 can cause long TLS handshakes). Example command included: `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` and a one-line note about why it helps.

jamie: Nice. Also remind operators to validate DNS overrides in sealed sites (we've seen kubelet cert fetches fail when internal hostnames don't resolve).

maria: added a DNS verification step to the smoke-test checklist (resolve kms.local and hsm.local from the installer VM). Replaced the old migration checklist link with the new URL.
